.auto-claude/specs/058-field-validasyon/.description: Complete parent→child table mapping for calculation-bearing child tables (22 total): COMMERCE: Order→items→Order Item, Sub Order→items→Sub Order Item, Quotation→items→Quotation Item, RFQ→items→RFQ Item, Cart→items→Cart Line, Marketplace Order→items→Marketplace Order Item, Commission Plan→category_rates→Commission Plan Rate, Payment Plan→installments→Payment Installment, Incoterm Price→price_breaks→Price Break, RFQ Quote→items→RFQ Quote Item. SELLER: KPI Template→items→KPI Template Item, Listing→pricing_tiers→Listing Bulk Pricing Tier, Seller Level→benefits→Seller Level Benefit. CATALOG: Product→pricing_tiers→Product Pricing Tier, PIM Product→prices→PIM Product Price, Product Class→completeness_rules→Completeness Rule. LOGISTICS: Shipping Rule→zones→Shipping Zone Rate (via Shipping Zone Rate child), Shipping Rule→rate_tiers→Shipping Rate Tier. MARKETING: Group Buy→tiers→Group Buy Tier, Wholesale Offer→products→Wholesale Offer Product. COMPLIANCE: Risk Score→scoring_factors→Risk Score Factor. Also Cart→items→Cart Item exists as alternative/separate child table.

Frappe_Marketplace/frappe-bench/apps/tra.description: Canonical dual-layer calculation pattern: order.py calculate_totals() implements subtotal=sum(items.amount), discount_amount=subtotal*discount_percentage/100, tax_amount=(subtotal-discount_amount)*tax_rate/100, total_amount=subtotal-discount+tax+shipping. Uses flt() for all numeric ops. Mirrored identically in order.js for client-side UX.

Commerce app has 18 child DocTypes. 11 have numeric calculation fields: Order Item (10 numeric: quantity, unit_price, discount_percentage, discount_amount, tax_rate, tax_amount, amount, lead_time_days, available_stock, weight), Sub Order Item (16 numeric: qty, delivered_qty, returned_qty, unit_price, compare_at_price, discount_value, discount_amount, line_subtotal, tax_rate, tax_amount, line_total, commission_rate, commission_amount, weight, shipping_amount, handling_days), Quotation Item (7 numeric: quantity, unit_price, amount, lead_time_days, available_stock, moq, max_quantity), RFQ Item (2 numeric: quantity, target_price), Cart Line (13 numeric: qty, unit_price, compare_at_price, line_total, discount_value, discount_amount, discounted_price, tax_rate, tax_amount, taxable_amount, weight, shipping_estimate, available_at_add), Marketplace Order Item (16 numeric), Cart Item (9 numeric: qty, available_qty, unit_price, original_price, price_change_amount, line_subtotal, discount_amount, tax_amount, line_total), Commission Plan Rate (4 numeric: commission_rate, minimum_commission, maximum_commission, fixed_amount), Payment Installment (6 numeric: installment_number, amount, paid_amount, days_overdue, late_fee_amount, total_due), Price Break (4 numeric: min_qty, max_qty, unit_price, discount_percent), RFQ Quote Item (4 numeric: qty, unit_price, total_price, lead_time_days).

Seller app has 14 child DocTypes. 3 have significant numeric fields: KPI Template Item (8 numeric: weight, display_order, target_value, warning_threshold, critical_threshold, max_score, bonus_multiplier, decimal_places), Listing Bulk Pricing Tier (4 numeric: min_qty[Int], max_qty[Int], price[Currency], discount_percentage[Percent]), Seller Level Benefit (1 numeric: display_order[Int]). Non-numeric child DocTypes: Listing Image, Listing Attribute Value, Listing Variant Attribute, Related Listing Product, Seller Application Category/Document/History, Seller Badge, Seller Bank Account, Seller Certification, Seller Tag Rule Condition.

Catalog app has 28 child DocTypes. 3 have significant numeric fields: Product Pricing Tier (5 numeric: min_qty[Float], max_qty[Float], unit_price[Currency], discount_percentage[Percent read_only], discount_amount[Currency read_only]), PIM Product Price (3 numeric: price[Currency], min_qty[Float], max_qty[Float]), Completeness Rule (7 numeric: weight[Float], min_value[Float], max_value[Float], min_length[Int], max_length[Int], min_media_count[Int], max_media_count[Int]). Most catalog child DocTypes are non-numeric (attribute sets, labels, descriptions, media, categories, etc.).

Frappe_Marketplace/frappe-bench/apps/.description: Cross-app child DocType numeric field summary: Logistics - Shipping Zone Rate (3 numeric: base_rate[Currency], rate_per_kg[Currency], estimated_days[Int]), Shipping Rate Tier (3 numeric: threshold_from[Float], threshold_to[Float], rate[Float]), Shipping Zone (no numeric). Marketing - Group Buy Tier (5 numeric: min_quantity[Float], max_quantity[Float], share_percent[Percent], unit_price[Currency], discount_percent[Percent read_only]), Wholesale Offer Product (3 numeric: quantity[Float], unit_price[Currency], total_price[Currency read_only]), Coupon Category/Product Item (no numeric). Frappe_Marketplace/frappe-bench/apps/*/.description: Complete field authorization scan across 120+ parent DocTypes, 7 apps, ~4572 total fields. Distribution: ~639 system-generated (14%), ~2280 admin-editable (50%), ~1653 user-editable (36%). Key patterns: (1) fetch_from+read_only:1 is universal for denormalized fields (120+ instances), (2) permlevel:1 used in Organization/Tenant/Seller Profile for admin-only fields, (3) set_only_once:1 is NOT USED ANYWHERE — critical gap, (4) Most status fields lack read_only:1 despite being workflow-controlled — another gap, (5) naming_series always hidden:1+reqd:1, (6) Deprecated fields use hidden:1+read_only:1 simultaneously. Turkish roles: Satici=Seller, Satici Admin=Seller Admin, Alici Admin=Buyer Admin, Alici Editor=Buyer Editor, Marka Sahibi=Brand Owner.

.auto-claude/specs/058-field-validasyon/.description: 124.md Cascading Discount System plan completed. Key design decisions: (1) Cascading formula final = base * (1-d1/100) * (1-d2/100) * (1-d3/100) always yields higher price than additive, protecting seller revenue, (2) 9 primary DocTypes need schema changes: Order, Quotation, Sub Order, Marketplace Order, Cart, Sub Order Item, Cart Line, Marketplace Order Item, Order Item, (3) Each gets 9 new fields: discount_1/2/3 (Percent, editable), discount_1/2/3_amount (Currency, read_only), total_discount_amount, effective_discount_pct, show_discount_tiers, (4) Existing discount_type + discount_value pattern in Cart Line/Sub Order Item is replaced with percentage-only cascading, (5) Coupon/promotion discounts apply as separate layer AFTER cascading, (6) UI uses progressive disclosure: only D1 visible by default, checkbox reveals D2/D3.

Complete JSON field inventory: 73 fields across 7 apps (50 JSON + 23 Code+JSON). 25 MIGRATE candidates: Commission Rule 6 fields (restricted_sellers, excluded_sellers, restricted_categories, excluded_categories, day_of_week_restrictions, override_by), Payment Intent 2 (partial_refunds, fraud_flags), Escrow Account 1 (partial_releases), Listing Variant/SKU Product/Product Variant images (3), Review images+flags (2), Message attachments (1), Moderation Case 3 (detection_flags, moderation_history, related_cases), Seller Balance recent_transactions (1), Seller Tier custom_benefits (1), Seller Score special_achievements (1), Listing 3 DEPRECATED (attributes, images, bulk_pricing_tiers), Seller Profile 1 DEPRECATED (badges). 48 KEEP fields: external API responses (8), configuration/templates (17), computed/read-only (7), polymorphic/debug (7), platform-specific/web standard (5), log/diagnostic (4). All apps use standard json.loads/json.dumps exclusively, zero frappe.parse_json/frappe.as_json usage.
